name: CreationMethod
summary: Returns an object ready for a test to use, so that the test names the situation it needs instead of assembling it.

roles.name: CreationMethod
roles.summary: A method that builds a valid object for a test, named for the situation rather than for the constructor it hides. Its assertion is that what comes back is usable as-is — a creation method returning something a test must finish configuring has become a constructor with a nicer name.
